title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: James Nicholas Leads U.S. Open
items.text: James Nicholas leads the U.S. Open at even par through the second hole, tied with Caleb Surratt, Ethan Fang, Jayden Schaper, and Jackson Suber.

items.headline: Fog Suspends U.S. Open Play
items.text: Heavy fog at Shinnecock Hills forced a suspension of play during Round 1 of the 2026 U.S. Open.

items.headline: USGA Toughens Shinnecock Setup
items.text: The USGA made changes to Shinnecock Hills aiming to make the 2026 U.S. Open one of the most difficult majors in years.
